mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 2.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where FEDFUNDS has been above 2.0% for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate and a decline in the unemployment rate signals aggressive monetary tightening amid strong economic growth, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with labor market strength
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS has increased and UNRATE has decreased in the same month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), a monthly increase in non-farm payrolls exceeding 0.5% signals strong labor market expansion that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS has increased by more than 0.5% month-over-month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures over the past 3 months indicates strong consumer demand that boosts corporate revenues, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where RSAFS has increased for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 1600.0 thousand units, it signals a contraction in the residential sector that reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where HOUST < 1600.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and industrial production indicates a broad-based economic slowdown in both the residential sector and manufacturing, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST and INDPRO have both declined in the same month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of weak industrial activity (INDPRO < 100.0), a monthly increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: industrial slowdown with labor market weakness
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO < 100.0 and UNRATE has increased by more than 0.2 percentage points month-over-month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.
